name: restart
description:
Restart services inside LXC containers that use outdated libraries, on one Proxmox host.

- **Restart all flagged services** is preselected: runs `needrestart-lxc -r`, restarting every flagged service (`systemctl restart`, with escalation to kill + start and SIGKILL when KillMode leaves children behind).
- Select **Dry run** instead to preview exactly what would be restarted without touching anything.

Non-systemd processes and scope units are reported but never touched automatically. Optionally limit the run to one container (CTID or name) and/or exclude services matching a regex (e.g. `^dbus|^rsyslog`)

parameters.name: Container
parameters.description: Optional: only this container (CTID or container name).

parameters.name: Exclude
parameters.description: Optional: regex of services to exclude (can use alternation, e.g. `^dbus|^rsyslog`).

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: Restart is preselected; pick dry run to only preview.

values_ui_mapping.dry-run: Dry run (show what would be restarted)
